messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Take Meloxicam exactly as prescribed by your doctor.

Use the lowest effective dose for your condition.
Meloxicam oral is taken by mouth.
Meloxicam injection (Qamzova, Xifyrm) is given as an intravenous bolus injection over 15 seconds.
A healthcare provider will give you this injection.
Your dose needs may change if you switch to a different brand, strength, or form of meloxicam.
Avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes.
Meloxicam doses are based on weight (especially in children and teenagers).
Your dose needs may change if you gain or lose weight.
If you use this medicine long-term, you may need frequent medical tests.
Store oral suspension, tablets, or capsules at room temperature, away from moisture and heat.
Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? C. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
